FISCAL NOTE

Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/30/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 224 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of Labor by a department-estimated $613,000 in Fiscal Year 2022, and an estimated $2.27 million annually thereafter, for costs related to additional personnel needed to conduct weekly random reviews of at least 10% of the proof of work searches provided by unemployment compensation claimants, as provided by this bill.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

committee: Sponsor: Orr Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/18/2022 FISCAL NOTE Senate Bill 224 (Act 2022-301) as enacted would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of Labor by a department-estimated $1.89 million in Fiscal Year 2023, and an estimated $2.27 million annually thereafter, for costs related to additional personnel needed to conduct weekly random reviews of at least 5% of the proof of work searches provided by unemployment compensation claimants, as provided by this act.
